prose:
[00:00.0-00:03.0] [image:protagonist] sits alone on the dark iron landing of a city fire escape at dusk, in an oversized gray crew-neck sweatshirt slipping off her left shoulder, with dark gray shorts and bare legs, a phone pinched between her right ear and her shoulder with no hand on it. Her eyes stay lowered and turned away from the lens, mouth closed, brows slightly drawn: a flat, drained expression; her head stays bowed while her body sways slightly forward on the step, arms straight down at her sides. Role: observed candid; she never looks into the lens. Medium shot from head to knees, eye-level with the camera a little below her face, her body centered and filling about two-thirds of the frame; the camera drifts like a handheld one (measured still 0.05 over the shot), the railings behind her shifting slightly between frames; action tempo slow. Scene: cool blue dusk light, a pale blue-gray sky over dark rooftops at the left, a warm-lit window in the building wall at the right edge; soft, shadowless light with a cold blue cast and a muted, realistic phone-camera look. A thin drawn caption sits near the top of the frame throughout. Sound: continuous sound with no word under it runs from 0.0 to 6.0 s at -18 dB (measured); 0.0-0.3 s is one of the three quietest stretches at -26 dB, and loudness peaks at 00:00.6 (-13 dB) and 00:01.9 (-19 dB) carry no word and meet no cut or visible change.

[00:03.0-00:04.2] No cut: the same shot runs on. [image:protagonist], in the oversized gray sweatshirt off her left shoulder, raises her right knee toward the lens at 00:03.0, then pushes her foot straight at the camera, the sole growing until it fills the frame by 00:04.0: the sole of a worn white sneaker, cream rubber tread in concentric rings with dirt-darkened heel and toe, a white lace hanging loose at the side. From 00:03.25 the sole hides her face; until then her eyes stay lowered. Role: observed candid, the kick aimed at the lens. Framing goes from medium shot to an extreme close-up of the sole, eye-level, the sole centered and growing from about a third of the frame to all of it; the camera drifts slightly (measured still 0.05 over the shot); action tempo moderate. Scene: the same cool blue dusk on the fire escape, soft shadowless light. From 00:04.083 the sole blurs out of focus and the picture washes to almost white by 00:04.208. Sound: the clip's lowest level, -30 dB at 4.2 s, falls as the sole covers the lens, and two of the three quietest stretches lie here, 3.3-3.6 s at -25 dB and 4.0-4.3 s at -27 dB (measured).

[00:04.2-00:06.4] Transition: out of the almost-white frame the next picture fades in over 00:04.250-00:04.375 (measured gradual change), milky at first, then grayed, then clear, with no hard edge. [image:protagonist] sits in the back seat of a car at night, first in profile facing left, in a strapless gold satin dress, cream satin opera gloves reaching above the elbow, a crystal drop earring, a jeweled clip in her low bun and glitter on her cheekbone, her left gloved hand resting on the door's armrest panel. From 00:04.5 to 00:05.5 she turns her head from profile over her left shoulder toward the lens, then keeps her eyes on the lens with a closed-lip smile to the end of the shot; her lips stay closed through 00:05.9-00:06.33. Role: direct address by look alone, no speech. Medium shot from head to thighs, eye-level, her body on the right half of the frame and filling about two-thirds of it; the camera is nearly static, the dome light and the glass edge keeping their places across frames (measured still 0.26, mixed); action tempo slow. Scene: a dark interior with one warm dome light above her, raindrops on the side window and out-of-focus city lights on a wet street beyond it; warm low key light on her skin and the satin against cool blue outside, a glossy, high-contrast, cinematic look. Sound: the change into this shot lands on a loudness peak at 4.36 s (+0.11 s from the cut's start, measured); further peaks with no word under them follow at 4.7 (-14 dB), 5.2 (-12 dB) and 5.7 s (-11 dB). From 00:05.98 the speech recognizer reports words, but her mouth stays closed, so they are not treated as her speech.

[00:06.4-00:07.8] Transition: hard cut at 00:06.375; frames 6.333 and 6.375 show no motion blur, nothing covering the lens and no blended, faded, white or morphing frame. Wide shot, eye-level, locked (measured still 0.92): a grand hotel entrance seen through open gold-framed glass doors at both edges, a polished dark floor, three crystal chandeliers hanging in a line down the center, a black car with its rear door swung open in the middle and a red carpet running from it toward the lens across the bottom third. [image:protagonist] steps out and starts walking toward the lens, in a gold satin slip dress with a draped asymmetric neckline, a long cream coat worn over her shoulders, cream gloves and clear strappy heeled sandals; her face is composed and her eyes are ahead toward the lens. Role: observed candid, a formal arrival. She stands centered and small, about a third of the frame height; action tempo slow. At 00:07.292 a one-frame flash: that frame is lighter than both neighbors (mean luma 54 to 82 to 55, not a mix of them, measured), a bright point of light bursting at the left while the framing and her place carry on unchanged across it; another burst of light flares over the car roof at the right at 00:07.5. Scene: warm amber light from the chandeliers, gold door frames and the deep red of the carpet; a rich, staged, glossy luxury look. Sound: the cut at 6.375 lands on a loudness peak at 6.34 s (-0.04 s) and the flash at 7.292 on a peak at 7.32 s (+0.03 s), measured; sound with no word under it runs from 7.3 to 12.1 s at -14 dB. The recognizer's words end at 00:07.22, with her face too small here to read her mouth.

[00:07.8-00:12.0] Transition: at 00:07.792 a flash: frames 7.792 and 7.833 are each lighter than their neighbors (mean luma 55 to 91 to 56, then 55 to 73 to 56; not mixes, measured), the picture washing bright while she is a step nearer. Wide shot, eye-level, the same hotel entrance with gold-framed glass doors at both edges and three crystal chandeliers in a line, the black car with its rear door open behind her. [image:protagonist] walks straight toward the lens in a slow, even runway walk, growing from about a third to over half the frame height along the red carpet, in the gold satin slip dress with its draped asymmetric neckline, the long cream coat over her shoulders trailing behind her to the carpet, cream opera gloves and clear strappy heeled sandals; her face is composed with a slight closed-lip smile and her eyes on the lens. Role: red-carpet arrival, eyes held on the lens. From about 00:08.3 pale petals start falling from above, and by 00:09.3 they fill the upper two-thirds of the frame. The camera is locked for most of the shot (measured still 0.42 and 0.40 in its first two seconds); action tempo slow. Scene: warm amber chandelier light from above and behind her, a glow along her hair and shoulders, the satin catching bright highlights; a rich warm grade, staged and glossy. Sound: the flash at 7.792 lands on a loudness peak at 7.80 s (+0.01 s), and the loudest point of the clip is -10 dB at 7.8 s (measured); further peaks with no word under them follow at 8.0 (-17 dB), 8.2, 8.6, 9.2, 9.7 and 10.3 s (-11 dB each), and 11.1 and 11.6 s (-12 dB), about every half second while she walks.

scene_entities.semantic: The one young woman the video follows: first dressed down and alone at dusk, then dressed for a formal arrival at night.
_notes: In the wide shots from 00:06.4 her face is small and reads slightly different from the close views; the edit presents one woman, and the large views do not settle it.

formula.function: Sets a deliberately low, ordinary baseline of the subject that the viewer recognizes from everyday life.
formula.mechanism: A one-line first-person excuse claims busyness while the picture shows idleness, and the small gap between the two makes the viewer wait to see which is true.
formula.viewer_state_after: Believes the subject is idle and has turned something down, and suspects the stated reason is a cover.

meaning_contract.attention_contract: Something will contradict this plain first impression.
meaning_contract.payoff_meaning: The ordinary version exists to be overturned.
meaning_contract.proof_surface: The dressed-down look and the excuse text together.

formula.constraint: Does the opening show the subject at their least polished, with one line of text whose claim the reveal will later contradict?
formula.retention_anchor: the gap between the stated excuse and the idle picture
formula.linguistic_craft: A clipped lowercase excuse whose understatement sets up a reversal.

formula.function: Breaks the still frame with a gesture aimed at the lens that blocks the view, signalling that a change is coming.
formula.mechanism: Something rushing the lens until it covers it gives a short, certain promise of a cut and hides what comes next, so leaving now means missing it.
formula.viewer_state_before: Expects the idle scene to continue.
formula.viewer_state_after: Knows the picture is about to change and is waiting to see what replaces it.

meaning_contract.attention_contract: The covered frame will open onto something new.
meaning_contract.payoff_meaning: The gesture is the door between two states.
meaning_contract.proof_surface: The frame-filling cover and the wash to near white.

formula.constraint: Does a body part or object move at the lens until it fills the frame, so the next shot starts out of that covered frame?
formula.retention_anchor: the fully covered frame just before the change

formula.function: Reveals the same subject in the opposite, high-status state, overturning the opening excuse in one transition.
formula.mechanism: The two extremes joined by a single transition reward the wait at once, and the subject's knowing look at the lens confirms the excuse was a cover the viewer is now in on.
formula.viewer_state_before: Believes the subject is staying idle.
formula.viewer_state_after: Knows the excuse hid a glamorous outing and that the subject is sharing the joke with the viewer.

meaning_contract.payoff_meaning: Saying no was a front for something better.
meaning_contract.proof_surface: The transformed look, the luxurious setting and the look to the lens.

formula.constraint: Does the first frame after the transition show the same subject in a state that plainly contradicts the opening line?
formula.retention_anchor: the look to the lens followed by the arrival

formula.function: Prolongs the reward with a slow approach toward the lens while celebratory effects build around the subject.
formula.mechanism: The subject growing in the frame while new visual elements keep accumulating adds novelty to the last frame, so the viewer stays for the full arrival and is set up to replay.
formula.viewer_state_before: Knows the reveal and is watching the arrival.
formula.viewer_state_after: Has seen the full transformation; nothing further is promised, which invites a replay.

meaning_contract.payoff_meaning: The transformation is complete and celebrated.
meaning_contract.proof_surface: The walk toward the lens with flashes and falling effects.

formula.constraint: Does the final shot keep adding visual elements while the subject approaches the lens until the last frame?
formula.retention_anchor: the subject meeting the lens at the end

dropped_as_music.why: Not taken as speech. Her lips stay closed in a smile through every frame from 5.92 to 6.33 s while the recognizer places its first word (mouth view, every frame), and her face is too small to read for the rest; the words are Korean while the only on-screen text is English; they sit inside continuous sound with no word under it (0.0-6.0 s at -18 dB, 7.3-12.1 s at -14 dB), the first word has probability under 0.5 and the last two share one start time. Whether this is a sung lyric, a voice in the track or a misrecognition of music cannot be judged without hearing.

tool_gaps: Text-like regions R1-R4 were all marked MOTION ONLY? and their boxes show no lettering on any overview cell (they cover her moving body and the walk), so they were skipped.
The top caption was not found as a fixed layer (only 4 of 12 one-second blocks had a moving picture to test against); its box was taken from the overview and read with text --name top_caption.

The text command measured the caption's fill as #76ACDA and its box as 0.028-0.082 wide, both from motion evidence; the image shows centered white lettering, so color and position were given from the reading.
The detected cuts at 7.292 and 7.792 are flash frames (measured lighter than both neighbors) over an unchanged framing; they are named as flashes.
